scenes.name: Bistro
scenes.subtitle: Amazon Lumberyard · Exterior
scenes.description: Sunlit café terrace with PBR materials, diffuse global illumination, ambient occlusion, and four cascaded shadows. Captured with TAA, 16× anisotropic filtering, and ACES at +0.6 EV. Original capture: 8 November 2026.
scenes.comparisonDescription: Matched SGL3D captures at 1920 × 1080 with a fixed camera and 720 warm-up frames. Each comparison disables one feature from the quality fixture. These are rendered images; the controls switch captures rather than rendering the scene live.
scenes.credits: Amazon Lumberyard Bistro by Amazon, CC BY 4.0. Prepared glTF conversion with corrected materials and authored lighting. San Giuseppe Bridge environment by Greg Zaal / Poly Haven, CC0.

scenes.name: Sponza
scenes.subtitle: Intel Sample Library · Atrium
scenes.description: Intel Sponza 2022 with the Curtains add-on, 4,095 diffuse GI probes, and an authored reflection probe for the covered gallery. Full-resolution rendering with ACES at +2.1 EV. Original capture: 8 November 2026.
scenes.comparisonDescription: Matched SGL3D captures at 1920 × 1080 with a fixed camera and 720 warm-up frames. Each comparison disables one feature from the gallery fixture. These are rendered images; the controls switch captures rather than rendering the scene live.
scenes.credits: Frank Meinl and Anton Kaplanyan (2022), Intel Sample Library, with the Curtains add-on crew. Original licence and credits retained. Kloppenheim 05 environment by Greg Zaal / Poly Haven, CC0.
